name: Jiangxi Jovo Energy Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangxi Jovo Energy Co., Ltd provides clean energy integrated service for gas industries in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Clean Energy Business, Energy Services Business, and Special Gases Business segments. The company is involved in procurement and sale of liquefied petroleum gas; procurement, production, and sale of natural gas; and chemical products, such as dimethyl ether, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride, heavy hydrocarbons, and other products.
